dashboard.heading: Welcome back, {shopName}
dashboard.subheading: Here's the current status of your shop.

settings.heading: Shop settings
settings.currencyHint: The currency new products are priced in. Products you've already listed keep the currency they were priced in.
settings.countryHint: Decides which of your shipping rates counts as domestic.

products.heading: Products
products.empty: You haven't added any products yet.

productForm.heading: New product
productForm.subheading: Add a product and its variants.
productForm.imagesHint: Add a few photos of your product.
productForm.optionsHint: Add options like Color or Size to create multiple variants. Leave empty for a single-variant product.
productForm.valuePlaceholder: Add a value and press Enter
productForm.editSubheading: Update this product and its variants.
productForm.statusHint: Turn this off to hide the product from your shop without deleting it. You can list it again at any time.
productForm.maxOptionsReached: You can add up to {count} options.
productForm.applyToAllHint: Fills every included variant with the base price plus its option adjustments. You can still edit rows individually afterwards.
productForm.tooManyVariants: Too many combinations — a product can have at most {count} variants. Remove some option values or exclude combinations.
productForm.tracksInventoryHint: Turn this off for made-to-order or digital items that never run out. Stock numbers are ignored while it's off.
productForm.shippingHint: Pick a profile, or leave as free shipping to cover postage yourself.

shipping.heading: Shipping profiles
shipping.subheading: Reusable postage rates you can assign to products — a small parcel costs less to send than a large one.
shipping.empty: No shipping profiles yet. Products without one ship free.
shipping.destinationHint: Use a two-letter country code, or * for everywhere else. A destination with no matching rate can't be ordered.
shipping.flatRateHint: Set “each additional” to 0 to charge one flat rate per order, however many the buyer adds.

Cart.heading: Your cart
Cart.someUndeliverable: Some items can't be shipped to your selected country.

Checkout.heading: Checkout
Checkout.subheading: Review your order and enter a delivery address.
Checkout.signInRequired: Sign in to place your order.
Checkout.countryHint: Changing this updates the shipping cost.
Checkout.undeliverableHint: Some items can't be shipped to this country. Remove them or choose another destination.
Checkout.splitHint: This basket will become {count} orders, one per shop — each seller ships and is paid separately.

Order.heading: Thanks for your order
Order.subheading: Order {reference}. A confirmation is on its way to {email}.
